lyrics:
[Intro: bluesy guitar lick, dark house kick, bass]

[Verse 1: smoky restrained male voice]
Check's on the bar, pen's in my hand
Band's on a break, I'd made a plan
Then the seat by you came free
Now the pen's just looking at me

[Chorus: fuller groove, voice doubled, guitar answering]
Stay or go, stay or go
One more round, or the bill
Stay or go, I don't know
I've been standing here so still
Stay or go

[Verse 2: voice closer, hi-hats open]
You look up, then you look down
There's a smile you don't quite hide
I could sign and say good night
I could ask what you're drinking tonight

[Chorus: fuller groove, voice doubled, guitar answering]
Stay or go, stay or go
One more round, or the bill
Stay or go, I don't know
I've been standing here so still
Stay or go

[Guitar Break: slow bluesy solo over the beat]

[Outro: groove, a stool pulled out, "Is this taken?"]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 116 BPM, 4/4, E minor. Slow, dark and smoky, a rock band at club tempo.

VOICE: Male, low, smoky and held back, almost murmured, with a tired warmth. Doubled in the choruses. One spoken line at the end.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean, bluesy electric guitar playing a short lick, a slow four-on-the-floor kick with a dry snare, a deep bass guitar, dark pads, open hi-hats, a Rhodes electric piano, a restrained guitar solo.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, guitar lick. 0:18 Verse 1. 0:48 Chorus 1. 1:16 Verse 2. 1:46 Chorus 2. 2:14 Guitar break. 2:42 Outro, a stool and a spoken line at 3:20.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2010s indie deep house: dark, warm and spacious, guitar and voice dry in front, kick deep.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Now the pen's just looking at me' at 0:42.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 10 p.m. A dark, guitar-led vocal track for the bar end of the pool.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Decided, undecided, tempted, asking.
